attchmntText: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting concluded on November 23, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 998.51 million rupees for the quarter and 1,640.52 million rupees for the half year. Profit after tax stood at 50.78 million rupees for the quarter and 117.78 million rupees for the half year. Basic earnings per share were 0.57 rupees for the quarter and 1.26 rupees for the half year. Total assets were 10,165.41 million rupees as of September 30, 2026. The statutory auditors issued a limited review report confirming no material misstatements.

attchmntText: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited has scheduled an earnings conference call for Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 04:00 PM IST. The call will discuss financial performance for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, of Financial Year 2026-27. Management participants include Chairman and Managing Director Mr. Sandeep Asolkar and Chief Financial Officer Mr. Amit Sawant. The intimation is filed under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Details are available on the company website.

attchmntText: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: SFC Environmental Technologies Ltd has appointed Adfactors PR Private Limited as its Public Relations and Investor Relations agency. The appointment is effective from November 18, 2026. Adfactors PR Private Limited is located at City Hall, Oasis Complex, Kamala Mills Compound, Pandurang Budhkar Marg, Lower Parel, Mumbai. The company filed this intimation pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The notice was issued by Shweta Deshpande, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The filing was submitted to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited on November 18, 2026.
